attackers_goals: An adversary may access user mail items from multiple IP addresses within the same subnet, which can aid in evading per-IP rate limits and avoiding detection while maintaining persistent access to a compromised mailbox.
description: A user's Exchange mailbox was accessed from multiple distinct caller IPs that all reside in the same /16 subnet within a short time window. This pattern is characteristic of VPS abuse and IP rotation designed to evade per-IP velocity controls.
investigative_actions: Enumerate every caller IP in the subnet that accessed the user's mailbox in the past 24h and check their SPUR/threat-intel reputation. Inspect the user's sessions: look for new OAuth grants, new inbox rules, MFA changes and revoke active sessions. Correlate the subnet/ASN with other tenant users to determine the scope.
name: User mail items accessed from multiple IPs in the same subnet

variations.name: User mail items accessed from rotating IPs in same subnet with anomalous properties
variations.description: A user's mailbox was accessed from multiple rotating IPs in the same /16 subnet, and at least one IP address contributed additional anomaly signals (e.g., unmanaged or risky caller IP, anomalous country or ASN for this user).
